registry_notes: The first 17 records describe the actual MCP surface in corel_operator/server.py.
Planned records are catalog entries only and are not exposed by the MCP server.
All current tools remain implemented_unverified until a reproducible X7 live-test report is recorded.
Current v0.5 wrappers return a legacy {error: string} object on failure; Batch 2 will introduce a stable result envelope.

success.warning: Subsequent editing operations will modify this document. Save a backup first.

success.coordinate_reference: object reference point is bottom-left; measurements are inches

success.warning: Resizing text objects by bounding box may stretch glyphs; changing font size is preferable for typography.

success.note: Imported objects may need move/resize operations. Inspect list_objects before printing.

success.warning: PDF settings inherit CorelDRAW preferences; verify page size, fonts, color profile, bleed and output settings.

tools.name: corel_status
tools.description: Report CorelDRAW connection, version, active document, and protected target-document state without editing a document.
known_limitations: Application.Caption is not confirmed in X7 documentation/type-library metadata.
Does not yet report bridge, MCP, pywin32, Python, ProgID, or capability-profile versions.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a new CorelDRAW document, set its first page size in inches, and bind it as the protected target document.
known_limitations: Returns requested rather than read-back page dimensions.
Does not assign a persistent document session ID.

tools.name: use_active_document
tools.description: Explicitly bind the currently active CorelDRAW document as the mutation target after confirmation.

confirm_existing_document.description: Must be true after the user explicitly authorizes editing the active document.

known_limitations: No automatic checkpoint copy or undo transaction is created.
Identity is an in-memory COM proxy and is lost on server restart.

tools.name: add_text
tools.description: Create editable artistic text on the active layer of the protected target document.
known_limitations: Insertion-point semantics and actual font substitution are not read back.
Explicit ANSI charset may not handle multilingual text correctly.

tools.name: draw_rectangle
tools.description: Create a rectangle using a lower-corner position and dimensions in inches.
known_limitations: Returns requested dimensions without actual bounds readback.

tools.name: draw_ellipse
tools.description: Create an ellipse from a requested lower-left bounding position and dimensions in inches.
known_limitations: Center/radius conversion and actual bounds have not been live-verified.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List top-level shapes on the target document's active page with basic identity, type, bounds, text, and outline data.
known_limitations: Shape indexes are unstable.
Nested group traversal is undefined.
Outline width is labeled as points without verified unit semantics.
Does not return fill colors, stable IDs, page/layer identity, or object rotation.

tools.name: set_fill_color
tools.description: Apply a uniform RGB fill to exactly one selected object in the target document.
known_limitations: Returns requested RGB values without reading the applied color back.
Does not check Shape.CanHaveFill before mutation.
RGB only; no CMYK/spot-color semantics.

tools.name: set_outline
tools.description: Set an object's RGB outline and requested width, or remove the outline when width is zero.
known_limitations: The MCP parameter is labeled points, but Outline.Width unit semantics are not yet established.
Color and width are not read back.
Does not check Shape.CanHaveOutline.

tools.name: move_object
tools.description: Move an object so its bottom-left reference point is at an absolute position in inches.
known_limitations: Page drawing origin is not inspected.
Result is rounded to four decimal places.

tools.name: resize_object
tools.description: Resize an object's bounding box in inches, optionally calculating one dimension to preserve its current aspect ratio.
known_limitations: Bounding-box resize can stretch text glyphs.
Resize anchor depends on document/reference state and is not explicitly controlled.

tools.name: set_text_content
tools.description: Replace all story text of one artistic or paragraph text object.
known_limitations: Formatting preservation is not verified.
Empty text is intentionally rejected.
Old text is truncated in the result.

tools.name: rename_object
tools.description: Assign a unique human-readable name to one object for later targeting.
known_limitations: Shape.Name is mutable and not a persistent bridge ID.
Uniqueness is checked only on the active page's enumerated shapes.

tools.name: duplicate_object
tools.description: Duplicate one object with an offset in inches and assign the copy a unique name.
known_limitations: Actual duplicate bounds are not read back.
Shape-index lookup relies on bridge-generated unique names.

tools.name: import_artwork
tools.description: Import an allowlisted local raster or vector file onto the active layer and name identified imported objects.
known_limitations: Allowed extension does not prove the installed X7 filter can import every listed format.
UNC/device-path policy is not explicit.
Fallback assumes new shapes can be identified by collection position.
Imported bounds and embedded/link status are not reported.

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Save the bound target document as a new CDR file using explicit X7 save options and refuse overwrite.
known_limitations: Creates missing parent directories without a separate allowlist.
Hard-coded enum values are now type-library-confirmed but not centralized in code.
No checkpoint/backup semantics for existing documents.

tools.name: export_pdf
tools.description: Publish the bound target document to a new PDF path without overwriting an existing file.
known_limitations: Does not verify the file exists after PublishToPDF returns.
Inherits CorelDRAW PDF settings.
Does not inspect page dimensions, bleed, fonts, color profile, or print readiness.

tools.name: list_open_documents
tools.description: List open documents with safe identity and dirty/path state without changing the active document.
known_limitations: Document session-ID and restart semantics must be designed before implementation.

tools.name: get_document_info
tools.description: Return identity, path, dirty state, units, page count, and active-page information for the bound target document.
known_limitations: Final identity schema depends on the stable document-session design.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List every page in the target document with index, name, orientation, dimensions, and active state.
known_limitations: Page collection enumeration and orientation enum still need registry records.

tools.name: get_page_bounds
tools.description: Return explicit lower-left, upper-right, center, width, and height values for one page in inches.
known_limitations: Drawing-origin and facing-page semantics require tests.

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description: List page and master layers with visibility, editability, printability, active state, and object counts.
known_limitations: Layer API inventory records will be expanded immediately before implementation.

tools.name: get_object_info
tools.description: Inspect one unambiguously selected object's identity, page/layer, type, bounds, transform, text, fill, and outline.
known_limitations: Final selector will change after stable bridge object IDs are designed.

tools.name: find_objects
tools.description: Search target-document objects using allowlisted criteria and return stable summaries without changing selection.
known_limitations: CQL will not be exposed until an allowlisted query design is proven safe; initial implementation may enumerate in Python.

tools.name: get_text_properties
tools.description: Return text content, type, font, size, style, alignment, and spacing for one text object.
known_limitations: Mixed formatting requires an explicit representation and additional X7 inventory work.

tools.name: get_fill
tools.description: Return the actual fill type and available color details for one object.
known_limitations: Color-model and complex-fill schemas require additional enum/member inventory.

tools.name: get_outline
tools.description: Return the actual outline type, color, width, and style for one object with explicit units.
known_limitations: Outline.Width unit semantics must be established before the schema can promise points.

tools.name: calculate_sheet_layout
tools.description: Calculate a deterministic N-up placement plan from item, sheet, margin, gutter, and orientation dimensions without touching CorelDRAW.
known_limitations: Initial algorithm will be rectangular grid packing, not arbitrary nesting.

tools.name: create_chest_number_batch
tools.description: Generate a validated sequence of editable chest-number designs with deterministic formatting and placement.
known_limitations: Depends on verified text sizing, font availability, alignment, duplication, and sheet-layout capabilities.

tools.name: arrange_n_up_print_sheet
tools.description: Apply a previously validated N-up placement plan to named objects or generated batch items.
known_limitations: Depends on stable object identity and a tested layout calculator.
